log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stderr/stdout.

num_devices.description: Number of virtual CD/DVD drives to expose (1–16).

audio_backend.description: Audio subsystem for passthrough: 'none' disables audio, 'pulse' uses PulseAudio, 'alsa' uses ALSA, 'oss' uses OSS.

audio_buffer_size.description: Audio buffer size in milliseconds (only used when audio_backend is not 'none'). Higher = more latency but fewer dropouts.

supported_formats.description: List of image formats the daemon will attempt to load. Format names are case-insensitive.

backend_modules.description: Backend modules to load at startup. Each entry is a module path, optionally with comment-style notes.

devices.description: Configuration for each virtual drive (up to num_devices entries).

driver.description: Drive type: 'empty' (blank drive), 'file' (image file), 'real' (physical drive), 'audio' (audio tracks), 'mixed' (image + mount).

image_path.description: Path to image file (used only for 'file' and 'mixed' drivers).

device_path.description: Path to physical drive (e.g., /dev/sr0) for 'real' driver.

mount_point.description: Mount point (e.g., /media/cdrom0) for 'mixed' driver (read-only ISO overlay).

pre.description: If true, sets track flag as pre-emphasis (rarely needed).

remote_enabled.description: Enable TCP/IP listener for remote client connections (e.g., from GUI tools on other machines).

remote_address.description: IP address to bind the remote listener to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces).

remote_port.description: TCP port for remote connections (CDEmu default is 2256).
